    .tag-product       { background: #E8F5E9; color: #2E7D32; }
    .tag-safety        { background: #E3F2FD; color: #1565C0; }

    /* ── Header ── */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; color: var(--text);
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-login {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border); color: var(--text);
      transition: border-color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }
    .btn-login:hover { border-color: var(--purple); background: var(--purple-dim); }
    .btn-login:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .hamburger-btn {
      display: none; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
      width: 44px; height: 44px; gap: 5px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }
    .hamburger-btn:hover { background: var(--surface); }
    .hamburger-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .hamburger-btn span {
      display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text);
      border-radius: 2px; transition: transform var(--transition), opacity var(--transition);
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    .hamburger-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* ── Mobile Nav Overlay ── */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 64px 0 0 0; z-index: 99;
      background: var(--bg); overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
      animation: slideDown 220ms ease-out;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    @keyframes slideDown { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .mobile-nav a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile {
      margin-top: 16px; display: block; text-align: center;
      background: var(--purple); color: #fff; padding: 14px 24px;
      border-radius: 100px; font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile:hover { background: #6020E8; }

    /* ── Hero ── */
    .hero {
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 92vh; display: flex; align-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FAF7FF 0%, #FFF8F2 50%, #F0EBFF 100%);
    }
    .hero-bg-blob {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: .35; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-bg-blob-1 { width: 600px; height: 600px; background: var(--purple); top: -150px; right: -100px; }
    .hero-bg-blob-2 { width: 400px; height: 400px; background: var(--orange); bottom: -100px; left: -80px; }
    .hero-inner {
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center;
      padding-block: 80px;
    }
    .hero-content { max-width: 560px; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;
      text-transform: uppercase; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 100px;
      background: var(--purple-dim); color: var(--purple); margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--purple); display: block; }
    .hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.02em;
      color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-title .gradient-text {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
    }
    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 36px; max-width: 480px;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
      padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 100px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #9B45FF 100%);
      color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(118,56,250,.35);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), opacity var(--transition);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(118,56,250,.45); }
    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }
    .btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .hero-visual {
      position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
    }
    .phone-mockup {
      width: 280px; height: 560px; border-radius: 44px; overflow: hidden; position: relative;
      background: var(--black);
      box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
      border: 6px solid #1a1a1a;
    }
    .phone-screen {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7638FA 0%, #FF7A00 100%);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; padding: 32px;
    }
    .phone-screen-logo {
      width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .phone-screen-logo svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; color: #fff; }
    .phone-screen-text { color: #fff; text-align: center; }
    .phone-screen-text strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .phone-screen-text span { font-size: 13px; opacity: .8; line-height: 1.5; }
    .phone-float-card {
      position: absolute; background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 12px 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 160px;
    }
    .phone-float-card.card-a { top: 60px; right: -40px; animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .phone-float-card.card-b { bottom: 80px; left: -50px; animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite .8s; }
    .float-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .float-icon.purple { background: var(--purple-dim); }
    .float-icon.orange { background: #FFF0E0; }
    .float-text { font-family: var(--font-head); }
    .float-text strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }
    .float-text span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); } 50%{ transform: translateY(-10px); } }

    /* ── Section shared ── */
    .section-label {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-label.purple { color: var(--purple); }
    .section-label.orange { color: var(--orange); }
    .section-heading {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.02em;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .section-heading .arrow { font-weight: 400; opacity: .5; }
    .section-body { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .text-link {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700;
      transition: gap var(--transition), color var(--transition);
    }
    .text-link:hover { gap: 10px; }
    .text-link.purple { color: var(--purple); }
    .text-link.orange { color: var(--orange); }
    .text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

    /* ── Features Section ── */
    .features-section {
      padding-block: 100px;
      background: var(--bg);
    }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; margin-top: 48px;
    }
    .features-content { }
    .features-heading { font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px); margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .features-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .feature-chip {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 100px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition), color var(--transition);
    }
    .feature-chip:hover { background: var(--purple-dim); border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); }
    .feature-chip svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .features-visual {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px;
    }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--surface); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 28px 24px;
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .feature-card:hover { border-color: var(--purple); transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .feature-card.tall { grid-row: span 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; min-height: 240px; }
    .feature-card.orange-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E8 0%, #FFE8D0 100%); }
    .feature-card.purple-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0EBFF 0%, #E4D9FF 100%); }
    .feature-card-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .feature-card-icon.purple { background: var(--purple-dim); color: var(--purple); }
    .feature-card-icon.orange { background: var(--orange-light); color: var(--orange); }
    .feature-card-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
    .feature-card h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .feature-card p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* ── Safety Section ── */
    .safety-section {
      padding-block: 100px;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #EDF5FF 0%, #F0EBFF 50%, #EDF5FF 100%);
    }
    .safety-inner {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center;
    }
    .safety-visual {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
    }
    .safety-card {
      background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 20px 24px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(118,56,250,.12);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition), transform var(--transition);
    }
    .safety-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateX(6px); }
    .safety-card-icon {
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .safety-card-icon.blue { background: #E3F2FD; color: #1565C0; }
    .safety-card-icon.green { background: #E8F5E9; color: #2E7D32; }
    .safety-card-icon.purple { background: var(--purple-dim); color: var(--purple); }
    .safety-card-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
    .safety-card-text strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .safety-card-text span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .safety-content { }
    .safety-heading { font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px); margin-bottom: 24px; }

    /* ── Creators Section ── */
    .creators-section {
      padding-block: 100px;
      background: var(--black); color: #fff; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .creators-bg-blob {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(120px); opacity: .25; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .creators-bg-blob-1 { width: 500px; height: 500px; background: var(--purple); top: -100px; right: -100px; }
    .creators-bg-blob-2 { width: 350px; height: 350px; background: var(--orange); bottom: -80px; left: -60px; }
    .creators-inner {
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center;
    }
    .creators-content .section-label { color: var(--orange); }
    .creators-heading {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px); font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .creators-body { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 32px; }
    .creators-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 36px; }
    .stat-item { text-align: center; }
    .stat-number { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--orange); display: block; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); margin-top: 4px; }
    .creators-visual {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; align-items: center;
    }
    .creator-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 3/4;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--purple) 0%, #9B45FF 100%);
      position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 20px;
    }
    .creator-card:nth-child(2) { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FF5500 0%, var(--orange) 100%); margin-top: 32px; }
    .creator-card::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,.6) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }
    .creator-card-inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .creator-card-inner span { display: block; font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .creator-card-inner strong { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; }
    .creator-avatar {
      position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 20px; z-index: 1;
      width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.25);
    }

    /* ── Tagline Banner ── */
    .tagline-banner {
      padding-block: 72px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple) 0%, #9B45FF 50%, var(--orange) 100%);
      text-align: center;
    }
    .tagline-text {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 52px); font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1.15;
    }

    /* ── News Section ── */
    .news-section { padding-block: 100px; background: var(--bg); }
    .news-header {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 40px; gap: 24px;
    }
    .news-heading { font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px); }
    .news-view-more {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--purple);
      white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .news-view-more:hover { color: #6020E8; }
    .news-view-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

    /* Carousel */
    .carousel-wrapper { position: relative; }
    .carousel-track-outer {
      overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scrollbar-width: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }
    .carousel-track-outer::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .carousel-track-outer.dragging { cursor: grabbing; user-select: none; }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex; gap: 20px; padding-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 300px; background: var(--bg); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border); overflow: hidden; scroll-snap-align: start;
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition), transform var(--transition), border-color var(--transition);
    }
    .news-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--purple-light); }
    .news-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--purple); }
    .news-thumb {
      width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .news-thumb-inner {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .news-thumb-icon { color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); }
    .news-thumb-icon svg { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
    /* card-specific thumbnail gradients */
    .news-card:nth-child(2) .news-thumb { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9B45FF 0%, #E040FB 100%); }
    .news-card:nth-child(3) .news-thumb { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF5500 0%, #FF9900 100%); }
    .news-card:nth-child(4) .news-thumb { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1565C0 0%, #42A5F5 100%); }
    .news-card-body { padding: 20px; }
    .news-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .news-title {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .news-date { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500; }
    .news-title-link { display: block; color: inherit; }
    .news-title-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }
    /* Carousel nav buttons */
    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); z-index: 10;
      transition: background var(--transition), border-color var(--transition), transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--purple-dim); border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .carousel-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .carousel-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .carousel-btn.prev { left: -22px; }
    .carousel-btn.next { right: -22px; }

    /* ── CTA Download ── */
    .cta-section {
      padding-block: 100px; text-align: center;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FAF7FF 0%, #FFF8F2 100%);
    }
    .cta-heading {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 60px); font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cta-sub {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px); font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 1.1;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .cta-buttons { display: flex; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .store-btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--text); color: #fff;
      font-family: var(--font-head); transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), background var(--transition);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .store-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); background: #1a1a1a; }
    .store-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .store-btn svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .store-btn-text { text-align: left; }
    .store-btn-text small { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; opacity: .7; }
    .store-btn-text strong { display: block; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }

    /* ── Footer ── */
    .site-footer { background: var(--text); color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); padding-top: 72px; }
    .footer-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 32px; padding-bottom: 56px; }
    .footer-col-heading {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    // ── Hamburger menu ──

    const mobileNav    = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');

    hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = hamburgerBtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isOpen));
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Open navigation menu' : 'Close navigation menu');
      mobileNav.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? '' : 'hidden';
    });

    // Close menu on nav link click
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open navigation menu');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    // Close on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && mobileNav.classList.contains('open')) {
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open navigation menu');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        hamburgerBtn.focus();
      }
    });

    // ── News carousel ──
    const trackOuter = document.getElementById('carousel-track-outer');
    const prevBtn    = document.getElementById('carousel-prev');
    const nextBtn    = document.getElementById('carousel-next');
    const SCROLL_AMT = 320;

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      trackOuter.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL_AMT, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      trackOuter.scrollBy({ left: SCROLL_AMT, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    // Drag-to-scroll on desktop
    let isDragging = false, startX = 0, scrollLeftStart = 0;

    trackOuter.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.pageX - trackOuter.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeftStart = trackOuter.scrollLeft;
      trackOuter.classList.add('dragging');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      isDragging = false;
      trackOuter.classList.remove('dragging');
    });
    trackOuter.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x    = e.pageX - trackOuter.offsetLeft;
      const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
      trackOuter.scrollLeft = scrollLeftStart - walk;
    });

    // Hide/show prev/next based on scroll position
    function updateCarouselBtns() {
      prevBtn.style.opacity = trackOuter.scrollLeft <= 8 ? '0.3' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = trackOuter.scrollLeft <= 8 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      const maxScroll = trackOuter.scrollWidth - trackOuter.clientWidth;
      nextBtn.style.opacity = trackOuter.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 8 ? '0.3' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = trackOuter.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 8 ? 'none' : 'auto';
    }
    trackOuter.addEventListener('scroll', updateCarouselBtns, { passive: true });
    updateCarouselBtns();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>SnapFrame — Capture, Create & Share What You Love</title>
  <meta name="description" content="SnapFrame is a social media platform that makes it easy to capture, create, and share what you love with the people who matter most." />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />

  <style>
    /* ── Reset & Tokens ── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    :root {
      --black:   #000000;
      --purple:  #7638FA;
      --purple-light: #9B6BFF;
      --purple-dim: #EDE8FF;
      --orange:  #FF7A00;
      --orange-light: #FFD1A8;
      --bg:      #FFFFFF;
      --surface: #F7F5FF;
      --surface2: #FFF8F2;
      --text:    #0D0D0D;
      --text-muted: #6B7280;
      --border:  #E5E7EB;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --radius-xl: 32px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.10), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
      --font-head: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      --transition: 220ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size: 16px; }
    body { font-family: var(--font-body); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; overflow-x: hidden; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }

    /* ── Utility ── */
    .container { max-width: 1200px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 24px; }
    .visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; }
    .tag-pill {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 100px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tag-announcements { background: var(--purple-dim); color: var(--purple); }
    .tag-tips          { background: #FFF3E0; color: #C05000; }
    .tag-product       { background: #E8F5E9; color: #2E7D32; }
    .tag-safety        { background: #E3F2FD; color: #1565C0; }

    /* ── Header ── */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; color: var(--text);
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-login {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border); color: var(--text);
      transition: border-color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }
    .btn-login:hover { border-color: var(--purple); background: var(--purple-dim); }
    .btn-login:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .hamburger-btn {
      display: none; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
      width: 44px; height: 44px; gap: 5px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }
    .hamburger-btn:hover { background: var(--surface); }
    .hamburger-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .hamburger-btn span {
      display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text);
      border-radius: 2px; transition: transform var(--transition), opacity var(--transition);
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    .hamburger-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* ── Mobile Nav Overlay ── */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 64px 0 0 0; z-index: 99;
      background: var(--bg); overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
      animation: slideDown 220ms ease-out;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    @keyframes slideDown { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text);
      transition: color var(--transition);

    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .mobile-nav a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile {

      transition: background var(--transition);
    }
    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile:hover { background: #6020E8; }

    /* ── Hero ── */
    .hero {
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 92vh; display: flex; align-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FAF7FF 0%, #FFF8F2 50%, #F0EBFF 100%);
    }
    .hero-bg-blob {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: .35; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-bg-blob-1 { width: 600px; height: 600px; background: var(--purple); top: -150px; right: -100px; }
    .hero-bg-blob-2 { width: 400px; height: 400px; background: var(--orange); bottom: -100px; left: -80px; }
    .hero-inner {
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center;
      padding-block: 80px;
    }
    .hero-content { max-width: 560px; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;

      background: var(--purple-dim); color: var(--purple); margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--purple); display: block; }
    .hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.02em;
      color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 24px;

  <script>
    // ── Hamburger menu ──
    const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburger-btn');
    const mobileNav    = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');

    hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = hamburgerBtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isOpen));
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Open navigation menu' : 'Close navigation menu');
      mobileNav.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? '' : 'hidden';
    });

    // Close menu on nav link click
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open navigation menu');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    // Close on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && mobileNav.classList.contains('open')) {
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open navigation menu');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        hamburgerBtn.focus();
      }
    });

    // ── News carousel ──
    const trackOuter = document.getElementById('carousel-track-outer');
    const prevBtn    = document.getElementById('carousel-prev');
    const nextBtn    = document.getElementById('carousel-next');
    const SCROLL_AMT = 320;

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      trackOuter.scrollBy({ left: -SCROLL_AMT, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      trackOuter.scrollBy({ left: SCROLL_AMT, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    // Drag-to-scroll on desktop
    let isDragging = false, startX = 0, scrollLeftStart = 0;

    trackOuter.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.pageX - trackOuter.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeftStart = trackOuter.scrollLeft;
      trackOuter.classList.add('dragging');
    });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      isDragging = false;
      trackOuter.classList.remove('dragging');
    });
    trackOuter.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x    = e.pageX - trackOuter.offsetLeft;
      const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
      trackOuter.scrollLeft = scrollLeftStart - walk;
    });

    // Hide/show prev/next based on scroll position
    function updateCarouselBtns() {
      prevBtn.style.opacity = trackOuter.scrollLeft <= 8 ? '0.3' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = trackOuter.scrollLeft <= 8 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      const maxScroll = trackOuter.scrollWidth - trackOuter.clientWidth;
      nextBtn.style.opacity = trackOuter.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 8 ? '0.3' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = trackOuter.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 8 ? 'none' : 'auto';
    }
    trackOuter.addEventListener('scroll', updateCarouselBtns, { passive: true });
    updateCarouselBtns();
  </script>
</body>

- **Footer** — 6-column grid (About, Features, Safety, Community, More, Partners), language selector, social icons, legal links

**Key interactions:**
- Hamburger menu toggles mobile nav overlay with Escape key support and body scroll lock
- News carousel: mouse drag, touch swipe, prev/next buttons with opacity feedback based on scroll position
- All focus states, ARIA labels, and keyboard navigation wired up
